_comment: Apply runner settings. A channel submits for real only after the user checked its headed dry run and ran npm run apply -- verify --channel <name> --evidence <that run's dir>, which sets verified and writes verified_log. Never hand-edit verified. Per-host company-site channels (site:<host>) are added by verify the same way.

auto_apply._why: Off until the user opts in (onboarding or later, recorded in profile/decisions.md). When on, a role is approved without a question only if: score >= min_score, every gate passes, its channel is verified and listed, and the CV coverage is >= min_cv_coverage. Tailored documents still follow preferences.tailoring.review.

companies._why: limit: the most live applications (approved or sent, including opportunity files at applied or later) per company; null turns the rule off. A pursue or approve past it is refused and names the siblings, auto-apply is blocked, and the runner never submits past a sent one. agencies: recruiter or staffing posters that count only as the end client the triage names (end_client); with no client named, only the same agency role posted again counts. aliases: {"Brand name": "Legal name"} for one company under two names.

accounts._why: ATS account creation needs a vault adapter (config/vault.json) and the user's opt-in. Without both, an account portal is handed to the user.

dice._why: The runner replaces the resume in the Dice wizard with the approved CV, then reads the Dice profile resume read-only to confirm it did not change. profile_resume: the file name of the resume on the Dice profile; empty lists the profile files without comparing.
